validationNotes: Start/post-verification actual nameKey counts9342/9345. Baselinec8836a86, clean tree/staging, no prior batch/test process running. Existing card definitions, IDs, catalogue, images, save formats and historical pending entries preserved.

Three full official original faces, stats, mana, current restrictions and four official images reviewed: Super Paladin2, Spike1, promo Slotton1. Only the exact Paladin reprint is equivalent; King the Slotton7/twin search results are distinct and excluded.

Super Paladin evolves over Liquid People, returns exactly one targetable opposing Psychic to its physical owner extra, and bounces all own/opposing Blockers on attack to actual owners without targeting. Its own actual Memento-granted Blocker bounces itself and cancels the attack only. Sealed targets excluded; actual Genmu suppresses its cost-five source abilities and W break.

Common Blocker matching now uses existing blockerAbility1675 through matchesEvolution, retaining both printed and granted Blocker presence while ignored. This does not restore block actions. Exact QA34384 actual Genmu/Memento/Woods is reproduced in related standard1675 in both seats; Super Paladin attack analogue also tested with explicitly ignored printed/granted Blockers.

Exact QA31545 Spike choices are mandatory independently per current own active creature including itself. Native Fire NEO optional evolution, paid six, power+5000/additive extra break or power+2000/untapped-creature permission, source departure, multiple stacking, no speed/sickness bypass, real end expiry, incarnation reset, ignored recipients/reactivation verified.

Promo Slotton reveals/protects exactly top three, requires all three Jokers, optionally deploys only a legal creature and separately offers all-or-none matching remaining-card recovery. Remaining any-card/twin costs, ordered bottom, failed all-Joker count, no creature/no base, actual Nature evolution and deployed Nefer follow-up are verified. No Slotton7 entry-attack permission is granted; the old Slotton7 pipeline is unchanged.

58 unique focused and374 affected regression tests pass,total432. Encrypted Spike mandatory mode and Slotton optional recovery choices round-trip with physical UIDs and legal actions. Updated legal forty-card seeded game conserves all80 physical IDs and finishes after JSON resumes. Check/audit/target9500/nameKey/baseline invariants all pass.

Fixture corrections: Candy Drop is Cyber Virus rather than Liquid People; actual Hulcus provides the Paladin base. Slotton itself is a legal Joker evolution base, so no-base tests use actual Zundoko Nature/Rexstar evolution; the positive base is Nature, not Fire. entryAbilities is a borrowing API, so invalid ignore tests were replaced with actual Waldo source entry suppression. No fixture failures were hidden or marked as implementation bugs.
Historical whole npm test status remains interrupted/unconfirmed; all prior individual/long/reprint deferrals remain unchanged. No whole long group rerun, push, publication or Netlify update.
